correctness.rationale: For both SRG(16,6,2,2) graphs the open neighborhood complex is generated by 16 size-six neighbor facets. Independently checked explicit permutations identify the facets of the Shrikhande and rook complexes; enumerated face vector (16,120,320,240,96,16) and all 808 nonempty faces. Both direct complete finite Morse reductions have 375 nonempty matched pairs, an acyclic directed Hasse graph and 1 critical 0-cell, 1 critical 1-cell, 56 critical 2-cells. Exact signed Morse cancellation gives degree distribution Shrikhande (0:39,+2:13,-2:4), rook (0:38,+2:9,-2:9), gcd 2. A one-circle 1-skeleton with fifty-six 2-cell maps of gcd 2 has homotopy type RP²∨55 S² via Nielsen changes on source circle wedge. Independent mod-2 and mod-3 chain ranks confirmed unique 2-torsion; field ranks alone would not establish homotopy.
